versions.subject: Local groups discovery sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_1:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '*/dscacheutil'
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '-q group'
selection_2:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '*/cat'
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '/etc/group'
selection_3:
  ProcessName|endswith:
    - '*/dscl'
  CommandLine|contains:
    - '. -list /groups'
condition: 1 of them
versions.spl: (ProcessName="*/dscacheutil" CommandLine="*-q group*") OR (ProcessName="*/cat" CommandLine="*/etc/group*") OR (ProcessName="*/dscl" CommandLine="*. -list /groups*")
